results.trackName: Red Maple Falls Series Bundle: Books 1-3
results.description:
Love blooms in the small town of Red Maple Falls, nestled in the White Mountains of New Hampshire, where family, friendship, and romance go hand in hand.

This steamy small-town romance collection includes the first three books in the beloved Red Maple Falls series, following the Hayes siblings as they find love in the most unexpected—and unforgettable—ways.

Book One: Mad About Matt

A hot cop and a sweet baker reunite years after heartbreak, discovering that second chances can be even sweeter than first love.

Book Two: Crushing on Kate

A grumpy newcomer and a sunshine-filled artist clash in a battle of wills that turns into undeniable attraction in this opposites-attract romance.

Book Three: Moments with Mason

A wounded woman and a protective boss find healing, trust, and love when a chance encounter changes everything.

Perfect for readers who love steamy small-town romances, found family, heartfelt emotion, and happily ever afters, this collection is the ideal introduction to the world of Red Maple Falls.
